project: AI-Driven Quantum Optimization for Dynamic Urban Mobility Management
data_policy: Saved project artifacts only; held-out test data are scored separately from train and validation data.

metric_definitions.MAE: mean(|prediction - actual|) over paired finite values
metric_definitions.RMAE_percent: 100 × MAE / mean(|actual|); NOT AVAILABLE when mean(|actual|) is zero
metric_definitions.RMSE: sqrt(mean((prediction - actual)^2)) over paired finite values
metric_definitions.R2: 1 - sum((prediction - actual)^2) / sum((actual - mean(actual))^2); NOT AVAILABLE for fewer than two values or constant actuals
metric_definitions.Pearson_r: Pearson linear correlation on paired finite values; NOT AVAILABLE for fewer than two or constant inputs
metric_definitions.Spearman_r: Spearman rank correlation on paired finite values; NOT AVAILABLE for fewer than two or constant inputs
metric_definitions.Top1_plan_agreement: count(predicted minimum-cost plan equals measured minimum-cost plan) / eligible snapshot or snapshot-junction groups
metric_definitions.S2_regret_s: measured SUMO delay for predicted-QUBO-optimum plan minus measured SUMO delay for the actual SUMO-optimum plan, same snapshot and plan grid
metric_definitions.feasibility_rate: S3: feasible raw solver samples / all raw samples. S2: held-out snapshots whose unconstrained serialized-QUBO global minimum is one-hot feasible / held-out snapshots; enumerated candidate-grid feasibility is reported separately.
metric_definitions.S2_pooled_Spearman: rank all candidate-plan outcomes pooled across held-out snapshots and correlate predicted QUBO energy with measured SUMO delay; denominator is the complete plan outcomes (512 here)
metric_definitions.S2_mean_snapshot_Spearman: arithmetic mean of within-snapshot Spearman correlations; denominator is held-out snapshots with defined correlations (2 here); this differs from pooled Spearman
metric_definitions.S3_exhaustive_search_space_feasible_frac: feasible assignments / all bitstrings exhaustively enumerated by ExactSolver
metric_definitions.S3_sampled_output_feasibility_rate: feasible returned samples / all raw sampled outputs from SA or QAOA; denominator differs from ExactSolver exhaustive search space

limitations: The modified medium_s0 raw files are training-seed data. The checkpoint and scaler are used as saved; no retraining occurs. Held-out ST-GNN scoring uses seed 4 only.
Phase 8 controller episodes are simulation outcomes, not a regression target or proof of controller improvement.
S2 v3 is marked scientifically unvalidated in its saved artifacts; plan-selection and regret results are diagnostic only.
QAOA results are from Qiskit Aer simulation, not quantum hardware.
